description: List the email templates this event can use: organization templates and event templates, names and ids only. Use it to find a templateId for draft_email or send_email. Returns organizationTemplates[] and eventTemplates[] with id and name, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_email_templates

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
